name: Harbour Light Inn
description: Twelve rooms above the old harbour, next to the ferry terminal. Busy bars and fish restaurants on the quay, so evenings are lively. Breakfast with a sea view.

name: Pine Shore Cabins
description: Wooden cabins on a calm forest lake, far from any road. Four-legged friends are welcome and the garden is fenced. Walking trails start at the door and you can swim from the jetty.

name: Hot Dog Corner Hostel
description: Budget hostel in the centre, right above a famous hot dog stand. Live music downstairs until late. Dog lovers, sorry: no animals allowed. A good place to stay if you want to be where the party is.

name: Fjord View Lodge
description: Lodge at the water's edge with kayaks and a sauna by the fjord. Pets welcome on request for a small cleaning fee. Most guests come for the silence.

name: Old Mill Guesthouse
description: Five rooms in a restored water mill by a slow river. Quiet, with homemade bread at breakfast. We can't take pets, because the owners have allergies.

name: Central Station Hotel
description: Two minutes from the main railway station. Meeting rooms, fast wifi and a 24-hour front desk for business travellers.

name: Dune Retreat
description: Beach houses behind the dunes, a short walk to a long sandy shore. Very quiet outside the summer holidays. Dogs are welcome and there is a shower for sandy paws.

name: Mountain Hut Seven
description: Basic hut at 1,800 metres, reached on foot in three hours. Bunk beds, a wood stove and starry skies. No road access.

name: Canal House Rooms
description: Rooms in a narrow canal house with windows right over the water. A lively area full of cafes and boats. Animals can't stay in the house.

name: Birchwood Spa
description: Adults-only spa hotel with a lake view, thermal pools and treatments. A calm place to switch off. No pets.

name: Island Lighthouse Stay
description: Sleep in a former lighthouse keeper's house on a small island, with only the sea and the birds for company. Your pet can come along on the boat.

name: Airport Express Hotel
description: Next to terminal 2 with a free shuttle every 15 minutes, day and night. Soundproof rooms for early flights.

name: Vineyard Manor
description: Manor house among the vineyards, with wine tastings in the cellar and long dinners on the terrace. Children over twelve welcome.

name: Riverside Camping Pods
description: Heated camping pods on a grassy river bank, with a fire pit for each pod. Bring your dog, there is room to run. Fishing permits at reception.

name: Design Loft Hotel
description: Industrial lofts in a converted printing works, a rooftop bar with DJs at the weekend and a gallery on the ground floor.

name: Family Farm Stay
description: Apartments on a working farm. Children can feed the goats and chickens, and there is a pond with ducks. Visiting animals are not allowed, to protect our own.

name: Seal Bay Cottages
description: Three stone cottages on a sheltered bay where seals sun themselves on the rocks. No neighbours, no traffic. Well-behaved companions on four paws stay free.

name: University Guest Rooms
description: Simple rooms on the campus, open to visitors during the semester breaks. Shared kitchen, close to the tram.

name: Old Town Boutique
description: Eight rooms in a 17th-century merchant's house on a quiet cobbled street in the old town. Pets can't be accommodated.

name: Lakeside Conference Centre
description: Conference centre on a large lake with 300 rooms, plenary halls and team-building on the water. Groups and events all year.
